description_en: Queries the list of API security export tasks
description_zh: 查询API安全导出任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-api-exports --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApiExports

parameters.help_en:
The language type. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型。取值：

zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the export task was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 导出任务的创建时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒

FileUrl.description_en: The download URL of the file

Format.description_en: The format of the exported file

Status.description_en:
The status of the export task. Valid values:

expired: The file has expired.

exporting: The export is in progress.

completed: The export is complete
Status.description_zh:
导出任务的状态。取值：

expired：表示文件过期。

exporting：表示正在导出。

completed：表示导出成功

Type.description_en:
The type of the export task. Valid values:

apisec_api: API asset task.

apisec_abnormal: API risk task.

apisec_event: API security event task
Type.description_zh:
导出任务类型。取值：

apisec_api：表示API资产任务。

apisec_abnormal：表示API风险任务。

apisec_event：表示API安全事件任务

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
